contentEn:
If you are planning a renovation in Metro Vancouver, the first question on your mind is probably: "How much will this cost?" The honest answer depends on project type, scope, material choices, and your neighbourhood. Unlike most renovation websites that give you vague national averages, we share real prices from our own completed projects across Metro Vancouver.

This guide covers every major project type — kitchen, bathroom, basement, whole-house, cabinet refinishing, and commercial — with cost ranges backed by actual 聚星装修 project data from 2024–2026.

Kitchen Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026

Kitchen renovations are the most popular home improvement project in Metro Vancouver. Prices vary significantly by scope:

  • Basic refresh (new countertops, cabinet door refacing, hardware, paint): $14,000–$20,000
  • Mid-range (full cabinetry, quartz countertops, tile backsplash, lighting): $25,000–$35,000
  • Premium custom (waterfall island, premium appliances, custom cabinetry): $35,000–$72,000

Real examples from our portfolio:

  • Coquitlam condo kitchen with budget-friendly cabinetry: $25,000–$27,000
  • Langley townhouse with white shaker cabinets and quartz: $20,000–$23,000
  • Langley kitchen with waterfall island design: $28,000–$30,000
  • Burnaby home with custom wood-vein cabinets and gold fixtures: $35,000–$40,000
  • Vancouver full custom with all premium finishes: $70,000–$72,000

Timeline: 3–6 weeks depending on scope and material lead times.

Read our detailed Kitchen Renovation Cost Guide →

Bathroom Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026

Bathroom renovation costs in Vancouver vary widely by size, fixtures, and whether you are doing a basic update or a full gut-and-rebuild:

  • Basic update (new vanity, fixtures, paint, minor tile work): $12,000–$18,000
  • Standard renovation (full tile, new shower, vanity, glass enclosure): $18,000–$28,000
  • Premium (heated floors, curbless shower, custom vanity, premium tile): $28,000–$45,000
  • Luxury / multi-bathroom (spa-level finishes, multiple bathrooms): $40,000–$60,000+

Real examples from our portfolio:

  • Vancouver master bathroom with custom features: $14,000–$16,000
  • Coquitlam standard bathroom with shower conversion: $14,000–$17,000
  • Maple Ridge bathroom with custom glass door: $18,000–$21,000
  • Richmond dual bathroom renovation: $25,000–$28,000
  • Delta three-and-a-half bathroom renovation: $40,000–$43,000
  • West Vancouver one-into-two bathroom conversion: $57,000–$60,000

Timeline: 2–4 weeks for a single bathroom, 4–8 weeks for multi-bathroom projects.

Read our detailed Bathroom Renovation Cost Guide →

Basement Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026

Basement renovations — especially suite conversions — are one of the best real estate investments in Metro Vancouver:

  • Basic finishing (rec room, bathroom, storage, no kitchen): $30,000–$45,000
  • Full suite (1-bedroom suite, kitchen, bathroom, separate entrance): $40,000–$65,000
  • Premium suite (2 bedrooms, full kitchen, laundry, high-end finishes): $60,000–$85,000

Return on investment: A legal basement suite in Metro Vancouver can generate $1,400–$2,200/month in rental income — the renovation can pay for itself in 2–4 years.

Timeline: 6–10 weeks including permit processing.

Read our detailed Basement Renovation Cost Guide →

Whole-House Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026

Renovating your whole house in one project is more efficient and typically 15–25% cheaper than doing each room separately:

  • Targeted update (kitchen + 1 bathroom + flooring + paint): $23,000–$35,000
  • Mid-range (kitchen + 2 bathrooms + living areas): $45,000–$75,000
  • Comprehensive (every room including basement): $80,000–$150,000+

Real examples from our portfolio:

  • Vancouver whole-house with bathroom updates: $23,000–$25,000
  • Richmond budget-friendly condo renovation: $26,000–$28,000
  • Surrey whole-house with custom cabinets and quartz: $29,000–$31,000

Timeline: 6–12 weeks depending on scope.

Read our detailed Whole-House Renovation Cost Guide →

Cabinet Refinishing Cost Vancouver 2026

Cabinet refinishing is the fastest and most affordable way to transform your kitchen:

  • Standard refinishing (10–15 doors, new hardware): $8,000–$12,000
  • Mid-range (doors + drawers + crown moulding + LED): $12,000–$18,000
  • Premium (solid wood doors + quartz countertop): $18,000–$25,000

Timeline: 5–7 working days with minimal kitchen downtime.

Read our detailed Cabinet Refinishing Cost Guide →

Commercial Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026

Commercial renovation pricing depends heavily on the type of space and compliance requirements:

  • Small fit-up (under 1,000 sq ft retail or office): $8,000–$30,000
  • Mid-range (1,000–3,000 sq ft restaurant or retail): $30,000–$80,000
  • Large project (3,000+ sq ft, specialised requirements): $80,000–$360,000

Real examples from our portfolio:

  • Burnaby commercial warehouse door renovation: $8,000
  • Burnaby Metrotown toy store renovation: $23,000–$25,000
  • Vancouver skin lab commercial transformation: $345,000–$360,000

Read our detailed Commercial Renovation Cost Guide →

What Affects Renovation Costs in Vancouver?

Several factors influence your final renovation cost:

  1. Scope of work: A cosmetic update costs far less than a structural renovation. Moving walls, plumbing, or electrical adds significant cost.
  2. Material selection: Builder-grade laminate countertop vs. premium quartz, stock cabinets vs. custom — materials can represent 40–60% of your budget.
  3. Property type: Condo renovations may require strata approval and are limited to certain construction hours. Heritage homes may need specialised materials and techniques.
  4. Permits: Structural, plumbing, and electrical work all require permits in Metro Vancouver. Permit fees range from $200–$2,000 depending on scope.
  5. Location within Metro Vancouver: West Vancouver and Vancouver West Side projects tend to cost 10–20% more due to higher material expectations and access logistics.
  6. Market conditions: Contractor availability, lumber prices, and supply chain factors all influence pricing. Get quotes from several contractors and compare line by line.

Why Our Prices Are Real

Every price in this guide comes from our actual completed projects — not industry averages, not estimates, not "starting from" prices designed to attract you. We have completed more than 100 renovation projects across Metro Vancouver, and we publish our real project data because we believe in transparency.

When you request a quote from 聚星装修, you receive a detailed written estimate with line-item pricing for each component of your renovation. No hidden fees, no surprise change orders, no vague allowances. Just honest pricing and quality workmanship backed by a 3-year warranty.

Get a free quote →

Prices reflect projects completed in 2024–2026. Material costs and labour rates may vary. All prices in Canadian dollars. HST/GST not included.

  • 中档装修（1,000–3,000平方英尺餐厅或零售）：$30,000–$80,000

影响温哥华装修费用的因素

几个因素会影响您的最终装修费用：

  1. 工程范围：美观更新远低于结构性装修。移动墙壁、管道或电气会增加显著费用。
  2. 材料选择：建筑级层压板台面与高端石英台面、现货橱柜与定制橱柜——材料可占预算的40–60%。
  3. 物业类型：公寓装修可能需要Strata批准，并限于特定施工时间。遗产房可能需要专业材料和技术。
  4. 许可证：结构性、管道和电气工程在大温哥华地区都需要许可证。许可费用从$200–$2,000不等，取决于范围。
  5. 大温地区位置：西温和温西项目往往因更高的材料期望和通道物流而贵10–20%。
  6. 市场状况：承包商的可用性、木材价格和供应链因素都会影响定价。从多个承包商处获取报价，逐行比较。
